onboarding_welcome_description: A modern internationalization solution for Flutter that eliminates code generation and merge conflicts.
onboarding_feature_sharded: Sharded by feature for team collaboration
onboarding_simple_description: Use natural English directly in your code with intuitive context extensions. Interpolation and plurals work seamlessly. Try changing the language above!
onboarding_sharded_description: Organize translations by feature in separate JSON files. Each team can work on their own feature without conflicts.
onboarding_benefit_conflicts: Fewer merge conflicts in large teams
onboarding_ready_description: You're all set! Start using shard_i18n in your app. Check out the example code to see how easy it is.
onboarding_tip: Tip: Use msgid for readable strings, or stable IDs for volatile copy that changes frequently.
